passages.title: Community Gardens
paragraphs: Community gardens allow residents to grow vegetables in shared spaces. Volunteers often maintain the gardens together.
Some gardens also offer workshops on composting and water conservation. Participation is voluntary.

questions.prompt: Community gardens provide space to grow vegetables.
What do some gardens teach about saving water? NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS.

passages.title: Public Libraries
paragraphs: Public libraries provide books and quiet study areas. Many also offer free internet access.
Some libraries run weekend workshops for adults. The workshops vary by location.

questions.prompt: The author states that public libraries provide study areas.
When do some libraries hold adult workshops?

passages.title: Cycling in Cities
paragraphs: Protected cycle lanes separate cyclists from motor traffic. Several cities have invested in new routes.
A survey of commuters found that safe parking was an important consideration when choosing to cycle.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for paragraph one.
Commuters valued safe _____. ONE WORD ONLY.
Protected cycle lanes separate cyclists from which traffic?
